transcript: i want a house in faisalabad under 2 crores
response: Ji bilkul, Faisalabad mein aapke 2 crore ke budget ke andar kai houses available hain – Nemat Colony No 2 (PKR 3 million, 2.5 Marla), Shalimar Park (PKR 3.5 million, 2.5 Marla), Jhang Road (PKR 7.5 million, 5 Marla), Madina Town (PKR 8 million, 15.5 Marla) aur Rehman Town (PKR 9.5 million, 3 bed/2 bath, 7.5 Marla). Aapko koi specific size ya location pasand ho toh batayein, main aapko agent se connect karwa dunga.
